actions.description: From the start-frame pose, the white arm pours hot dark-brown coffee from the kettle spout into the right-hand drinking glass; the black gripper stays idle

Wrong-vessel diversion: the wrist moves the kettle spout left until the entire single coffee stream enters the open instant-coffee jar to the left of the drinking glass. For about three seconds the stream lands only inside the jar, wetting the granules. Zero new coffee enters the right glass during this interval; its existing coffee remains inside and its fill level pauses

Correction: the arm moves the spout back over the right drinking glass, resumes filling it with dark reddish-brown coffee, and settles into the end-frame pose with the kettle more upright and the glass fuller, matching seed_end.png

temporal_caption: The video is anchored to provided start and end frames of a tabletop robot pouring hot dark-brown coffee from a pale kettle into a clear drinking glass on a glossy white table, with an open instant-coffee jar to the left of the glass and a black three-finger gripper idle in the foreground. The liquid is brewed coffee: rich reddish-brown in the glass and amber-brown in the falling stream. It begins matching the start image with one continuous stream landing inside the right-hand drinking glass. Midway, the white arm moves the kettle spout left, and that same single, unbranched stream enters the open left coffee jar among the granules for about three seconds. During this interval zero new coffee enters the right glass: the coffee already inside remains visible and its level does not rise. The arm then moves the same stream back over the right glass and finishes matching the end image with fuller coffee and a more upright kettle. There is never a second stream, never simultaneous pouring into both vessels, and never a table spill as the main event. Camera and objects remain fixed and consistent; there are no cuts.
